subject.title: refactor(config): retire legacy flat streaming keys to doctor-owned migration

question: Does the approval to remove runtime flat-key tolerance also authorize changing the shipped `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-streaming` resolver behavior for external plugins?
rationale: The PR body expressly accepts bundled startup rejection and accelerated alias retirement, but does not expressly cover plugin-owned values that bundled doctor migrations cannot repair.

options.title: Preserve SDK flat reads
options.body: Keep flat fallback behavior in the public resolver family while removing it from validated bundled runtime paths.

options.title: Approve a versioned break
options.body: Explicitly accept the SDK behavior change with external-plugin migration guidance and focused compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Preserve SDK flat reads
recommendation.body: Keep flat fallback behavior in the public resolver family while removing it from validated bundled runtime paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The nested-streaming and public resolver contract originated in this contributor's merged feature work, making them the strongest historical routing candidate.
